workloads.name: Root cause across related support tickets

request.task: Identify the shared root cause, affected requests, and verified remediation across the support tickets.

documents.title: Ticket 441
documents.text: Symptom: some signed requests returned 401 after deployment. Browser sessions were unaffected. Initial suspicion was clock drift.

documents.title: Ticket 442
documents.text: Correlation: every failing request used a service token minted before key version K-9. Requests minted after K-9 succeeded.

documents.title: Postmortem 44
documents.text: Root cause: the verifier stopped loading public key K-8 immediately after K-9 activated, even though K-8 tokens remained valid for one hour. The remediation keeps the prior verification key for a two-hour overlap and was verified against both K-8 and K-9 fixtures.

documents.title: Ticket 443
documents.text: A separate user reported a malformed JSON body. It was rejected before authentication and is unrelated to the key-rotation incident.

requiredFacts.statement: The verifier removed K-8 before still-valid K-8 tokens expired.
evidence: Root cause: the verifier stopped loading public key K-8 immediately after K-9 activated, even though K-8 tokens remained valid for one hour.

requiredFacts.statement: Failures affected tokens minted before K-9.
evidence: Correlation: every failing request used a service token minted before key version K-9.

requiredFacts.statement: The prior key is now retained for a two-hour overlap and tested with both key versions.
evidence: The remediation keeps the prior verification key for a two-hour overlap and was verified against both K-8 and K-9 fixtures.

mustNotAssert: Clock drift was the confirmed cause.

workloads.name: Material difference between near-duplicate procedures

request.task: Give the production credential-rotation sequence, identifying the step that differs from staging and the required verification.

documents.title: Staging rotation
documents.text: Create the replacement key. Update the staging secret. Restart the staging worker. Revoke the old key immediately. Confirm one unsigned health probe returns 401.

documents.title: Production rotation
documents.text: Create the replacement key. Update the production secret through the reviewer-protected environment. Keep the prior key active for a 30-minute overlap. Confirm one signed canary succeeds with the replacement key, then revoke the prior key.

documents.title: Unreviewed copy
documents.text: Create the replacement key. Update the production secret. Restart the worker. Revoke the old key immediately. This copy is unreviewed and must not be used for production.
